purpose: Register every receipt required to close an open UNKNOWN or to convert a sensitivity into a deployable claim. A receipt is only valid when it is primary, dated, attributable to a specific asset, and states its measurement boundary.
rules: No value enters a run until its receipt is on file and its evidence class is assigned.
UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN until a receipt exists. It is never backfilled from aggregate node performance.
A receipt that contradicts an existing value does not overwrite it; both are preserved and the disagreement is annotated.
Planned or permitted capacity never populates a current operating state.
A vendor or model specification is not a performance receipt.

priority_legend.P0: Blocks a current-cost, current-performance or compliance claim.
priority_legend.P1: Blocks promotion of a sensitivity to a deployment decision.
priority_legend.P2: Improves resolution or reduces uncertainty but does not block.

receipts.description: Plant-specific 2026 electricity bill, retail contract or market-settlement statement for the desalination works.
receipts.why_it_matters: Without it, every CNY figure for the node remains UNKNOWN and no current economics claim can be made. The 0.555 CNY/kWh historical tariff is a counterfactual only.

receipts.description: Whole-site specific energy consumption, measured at the site boundary, distinguishing process-train SEC from total site SEC including intake, pretreatment, post-treatment, distribution and auxiliaries.
receipts.why_it_matters: The 2.2 kWh/m3 figure is process-train SEC. Presenting it as whole-site SEC would understate site energy by an unknown margin.

receipts.description: Incremental auxiliary energy attributable to any retrofit measure, measured before and after.
receipts.why_it_matters: A retrofit saving cannot be claimed without the incremental auxiliary load it introduces.

receipts.description: Dated measured recovery fraction for the operating plant, as distinct from the 45-50% technology and application range.
receipts.why_it_matters: The 45-50% band is a technology range, not a measured value for this plant. Using it as though it were measured promotes an assumption to a fact.
blocks: feed and reject mass balance as a current claim

receipts.description: Current feed, permeate, concentrate and blend stream map with flow directions and destinations.
receipts.why_it_matters: Reject-equivalent is modelled as feed minus product. That is not a discharge quantity and cannot become one without this map.

receipts.description: Current brine and concentrate composition, including salinity, key ions, and any pretreatment residuals.
receipts.why_it_matters: Brine chemistry is a precondition for any resource-recovery claim, including the proposed magnesium-to-struvite coupling.

receipts.description: Observed fouling rate and cleaning frequency history with the normalisation basis.
required_fields: normalised differential pressure or flux decline
receipts.why_it_matters: A procurement event is not evidence of a fouling benefit. Membrane-life and fouling claims require this history.

receipts.description: Current clean-in-place protocol and chemical additive chemistry, with doses and setpoints.
receipts.why_it_matters: The sono-CIP measure and the compute-to-CIP heat coupling both depend on the actual thermal duty and schedule.

receipts.description: Primary ecological monitoring data for the receiving water body, sufficient to assess INV-19.
receipts.why_it_matters: INV-19 is a veto. A data centre cannot be called regenerative if downstream water quality deteriorates, and a secondary summary cannot be promoted to measured primary data.

receipts.description: Survey of genuinely unused, dissipated hydraulic head on the product or process stream.
receipts.why_it_matters: Run 2 is a transfer function only. Without this survey, hydro credit stays zero. The 400-630 m SWRO pump head is motor-supplied and is excluded from any recovery claim.

receipts.description: Structural assessment of the desalination workshop roof and the available interconnection capacity.
receipts.why_it_matters: The 17,474.32 m2 roof and 60% active coverage are modelled. Without a structural and interconnection assessment the PV case is a site-layout sensitivity, not a project.

receipts.description: Measured power usage effectiveness at the pilot boundary, with the boundary stated explicitly.
receipts.why_it_matters: PUE = 1.25 is a sector policy reference, not a Node-001 receipt. Until measured, facility energy is a scenario.

receipts.description: Measured water usage effectiveness with the water source identified.
receipts.why_it_matters: Cooling water cannot quietly consume desalinated product water while claiming a separate water benefit.

receipts.description: Identification of the compute cooling water source and its accounting treatment.
receipts.why_it_matters: A cooling load sourced from desalinated product water is a new water demand, not a benefit.

receipts.description: Hourly PV AC output and hourly compute load, on a common timebase.
receipts.why_it_matters: Annual-energy magnitude similarity is not hourly self-powering. Without an overlap trace, the S01-to-C01 relationship cannot be claimed.

receipts.description: Evidence of actual PV curtailment or export limitation.
receipts.why_it_matters: C01 can only be argued electrically neutral if verified curtailment is captured or new generation and savings are added. Without curtailment evidence, routing existing S01 energy to compute merely changes attribution.

receipts.description: Thermal coupling measurement set: coolant supply and return temperature, recoverable thermal power, CIP target temperature, CIP schedule, CIP thermal duty, and heat-pump COP map.
receipts.why_it_matters: Useful-heat credit is zero. Thermal quantity is not electric value. Credit requires all three matching factors and a displaced measured load.

receipts.description: Before/after KPI evidence for model-assisted operation, with the counterfactual period defined.
receipts.why_it_matters: Model service benefit stays zero until measured. Model consensus is not evidence and tokens per kWh is not a sufficient KPI.

receipts.description: Node-specific allocation under the regional direct-green pathway, with the eligible load set and contract price.
acceptable_sources: signed power purchase or direct-green agreement
receipts.why_it_matters: The regional plan reports about 214 MW of planned wind and about 81 MW of planned PV around Qianwan and Dongjiakou. That is a regional plan, not a node allocation, and the node access field is UNKNOWN.

receipts.description: Node-specific feedstock allocation or on-node generation receipt, plus measured biogas quantity and methane composition.
receipts.why_it_matters: Municipal food-waste feedstock is zero until an allocation or on-node generation receipt exists. The Qingdao precedent is retrospective and belongs to another site.

receipts.description: Digestate nutrient mass, product assay, compost mass and quality, and verified reclaimed-water reuse displacement.
receipts.why_it_matters: One N, P or Mg mass cannot receive both a recovery credit and a compost credit. Reclaimed water is credited only when verified reuse displaces another source.
blocks: BIO01 nutrient, compost and water credits

receipts.description: Selection and characterisation of an eligible high-COD wastewater sidestream, with the existing treatment plant as the compliance baseline.
receipts.why_it_matters: The 0.35 m3 CH4 per kg biodegradable COD figure is a stoichiometric ceiling, not a plant yield. Existing AO/MBBR treatment remains the compliance baseline and new anaerobic treatment must be incremental.

receipts.description: Written confirmation of the OT/IT segmentation design, the read-only telemetry path, and the approval gate before any PLC/SCADA write path exists.
receipts.why_it_matters: LLM actuator authority is NONE and models receive no OT write credentials. This is a precondition, not a deliverable of the pilot.

lattice_level_receipts.description: A sourced, evidence-classed register of Chinese localities hosting seawater desalination capacity, for candidate node instantiation.
lattice_level_receipts.why_it_matters: A 167-node lattice claim requires a sourced node register. Locality names, capacities and status must be REPORTED or better, never inferred.

lattice_level_receipts.description: Per-node current resource and production statistics, acquired under a common schema so nodes are comparable.
lattice_level_receipts.why_it_matters: Cross-node comparison and any lattice-level aggregate require a shared schema and per-node provenance. An aggregate may never be attributed back to a single node.

lattice_level_receipts.description: Lattice conservation rules preventing a single physical resource from receiving credits in more than one node.
lattice_level_receipts.why_it_matters: The node-level single-credit rule must hold at lattice scale, or the aggregate becomes double-counted.
